candidates.statement: Inventory's redis.reserve_inventory calls time out (DependencyUnavailable: redis operation failed), causing inventory /v1/reservations 503s, order ReadTimeouts, and gateway /v1/checkout 502s at ~2s.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts in inventory propagating to order ReadTimeouts and gateway 502s on /v1/checkout; topology confirms gateway->order->inventory->redis. Bounded to redis-timeout; redis-side telemetry absent.
